prompt: Photograph of an architect's presentation model on a dark green self-healing cutting mat. A long white bridge model spans a gap between two small white city blocks. The bridge is built from clean white foamboard and museum card with crisp knife-cut edges. Exactly one span in the middle of the bridge is bright cutter-yellow, the single missing piece now set in place. A few tiny scale-model figures of a man in a navy suit stand on the bridge deck; one climbs a tiny wooden ladder against a pier. The model sits in the right two thirds of the frame; the left third is empty green cutting mat. Three-quarter elevated view. Soft north-window daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows on the mat, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, studio product photography. The mat is plain deep green with only a very faint fine grid. No text, no numbers, no logos, no hands, no tools.
